method: HLTV first (match, event and team pages read directly; this environment is not 403'd by HLTV the way the CI runners are), then esportsbooks/exchanges (Polymarket event page, EGamersWorld aggregation, bo3.gg), then the official Valve VRS standings committed at data/evidence/valve-ratings.json (2026-10-05) replayed with the project's own model formula (scripts/domain.py valve_analysis, RD 75). HLTV fan votes and Polymarket best-ask displays are recorded as what they are, never as win probabilities.

reads.found: Fixture confirmed: GLuck Moscow Cyber Games 2026, Best of 3 (LAN) semi-final, 31 Oct 2026 (countdown 5d 18h 43m at read time, i.e. 09:00Z, matching Hotspawn). Lineups: HOTU = dwushka, frontales, mizu, n0rb3r7, kade0; The Huns = Bart4k, controlez, bexyz, Cozen, DarkMeister. Rankings shown on the page: HOTU HLTV #38 / VRS #38; The Huns HLTV #134 / VRS #122. The HLTV betting panel rendered no numeric odds pair (promocode row only). 'Pick a winner' fan vote read HOTU 76.0% / The Huns 24.0%.
reads.verdict: Identity evidence. The Huns' playing core matches 4 of 5 players of Valve's 944-point row (#122 in the committed 2026-10-05 standings; DarkMeister in place of Annihilation) and only 2 of 5 of the 701-point row (#213), and HLTV's own VRS link for the team resolves to #122. HOTU's lineup is 5 of 5 of its Valve row (1437 points). The fan vote is sentiment, not a probability; no line is taken from HLTV.

reads.source: Valve official standings (committed evidence, replayed with the project formula)
reads.found: data/evidence/valve-ratings.json (standings 2026-10-05) carries HOTU once (#31, 1437 pts) and The Huns twice (#122, 944 pts, roster Annihilation/Bart4k/bexyz/controlez/Cozen; #213, 701 pts, roster Bart4k/controlez/nin9/sk0R/xerolte). Replaying scripts/domain.py valve_analysis (RD 75): HOTU 94.1% against the #122 roster, 98.4% against the #213 roster.
reads.verdict: Cross-check only, computed and labelled as the project's uncalibrated research model. Against the HLTV-verified core the model says 94.1%, i.e. about 4 points below the published network figure. Direction agrees (HOTU).

fixtures.verdict: Pick direction HOTU is corroborated by every source read (HLTV rankings #38 vs #134, the Valve points gap on either roster, the shape of the Polymarket book, EGW's fixture framing). The published 98.2% magnitude rests solely on the project's uncalibrated network fit: the project's own Valve model on the HLTV-verified roster gives 94.1%, and no usable bookmaker or exchange line exists today to arbitrate. The figure is left untouched and flagged for review (27ac20d6-1082792-magnitude). Mechanically this is expected to self-correct: the fixture is six days out and every 4-hour refresh re-runs the ladder, so a tightening Polymarket book (spread <= 0.15) would replace the model number with a market line automatically.
limitations: No exact-five-player HLTV proof exists for The Huns: the event lineup differs from Valve's #122 row by one player (DarkMeister for Annihilation), so the ladder's strict uniqueness rule still cannot take the Valve rung unaided. Disambiguation by 4-of-5 core plus HLTV's own VRS #122 link is recorded here as evidence for a future ladder rung, not applied.
Valve points used in the cross-check are the committed 2026-10-05 standings; HLTV's live VRS mirror (25 Oct) already ranks HOTU #38, so points have drifted since the file the pipeline used.
Polymarket figures are best asks on a $690 book, recorded to show why no line could be read; they are not win probabilities.
Hotspawn best-of was unverified in the snapshot and left blank; HLTV lists this match as Best of 3 (LAN). The snapshot value is not edited from this session.

reads.found: LFO 10 is HLTV team 14084 (Sweden). Listed starters dottie, flaw, Sapec, each '10 days' on the team at read time, i.e. the core formed around 15 Oct 2026. HLTV world ranking #167; HLTV's Valve-ranking mirror shows VRS #156 (Europe #111) dated 2026-10-25.

A newer standings file does carry the team (per HLTV's mirror), so a later refresh may resolve the name exactly. No probability is derived from rankings.

fixtures.verdict: Identity and blocker fully verified; the published resolution path (verified alias into four independent money sources) is the documented ladder behaviour for exactly this situation. The fixture locked before this session began, so the dossier records provenance only. Flagged as information (27ac20d6-lfo10-vrs-now-exists): a future refresh with a post-15-Oct standings file should resolve 'LFO 10' by exact name, retiring this blocker class for the team.
limitations: All reads are post-lock (match started 12:00Z); no prematch price is re-observed and no retrospective probability is manufactured.
HLTV lists only three starters for LFO 10 plus stand-ins, so even with a newer standings file a roster-exact Valve join may remain unavailable; the exact-name team row is what the model consumes.

The consensus inputs themselves (four order books at 05:12Z) are pipeline-captured evidence on the origination card; they cannot be re-read after the start and are not re-verified here beyond identity.
